pairs: Dominus illuminatio mea et salus mea:
The Lord is my light and my salvation,
The Lord is the protector of my life,
of whom shall I be afraid?
Dum appropiant super me nocentes ut edant carnes meas,
Meanwhile, the guilty draw near to me, so as to eat my flesh.
Those who trouble me, my enemies,
have themselves been weakened and have fallen.
If entrenched armies were to stand together against me,
If a battle were to rise up against me,
I would have hope in this.
One thing I have asked of the Lord,
ut inhabitem in domo Domini omnibus diebus vitæ meæ;
that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life,
so that I may behold the delight of the Lord,
Quoniam abscondit me in tabernaculo suo;
For he has hidden me in his tabernacle.
in die malorum protexit me in abscondito tabernaculi sui.
In the day of evils, he has protected me in the hidden place of his tabernacle.
He has exalted me upon the rock,
et nunc exaltavit caput meum super inimicos meos.
and now he has exalted my head above my enemies.
I have circled around and offered a sacrifice of loud exclamation in his tabernacle.
et immolavi in tabernaculo ejus hostiam vociferationis;
and I will compose a psalm,
vocem meam, qua clamavi ad te;
with which I have cried out to you.
My heart has spoken to you;
Ne avertas faciem tuam a me;
Do not turn your face away from me.
ne declines in ira a servo tuo. Adjutor meus esto;
In your wrath, do not turn aside from your servant.
Be my helper. Do not abandon me,
Quoniam pater meus et mater mea dereliquerunt me;
For my father and my mother have left me behind,
but the Lord has taken me up.
O Lord, establish a law for me in your way,
in via tua, et dirige me in semitam rectam,
and direct me in the right path,
Ne tradideris me in animas tribulantium me,
Do not surrender me to the souls of those who trouble me.
quoniam insurrexerunt in me testes iniqui,
For unjust witnesses have risen up against me,
and iniquity has lied to itself.
Credo videre bona Domini in terra viventium.
I believe that I shall see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.
and let your heart be strengthened,
